messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired — PD12345 — gpu-node-8b-12 is UNREACHABLE (kubelet NotReady). Trigger: node-heartbeat-missed (2m). Affected service: inference-prod-us-east-1.

pagerduty-bot: Assigned to sre-oncall. Escalation policy: oncall -> backup -> eng-lead. Please ack to stop repeats.

Alex M: acked. Iʼm on it.

Maya K: joining. any customers impacted?

Samir: I'm seeing elevated 5xx for a small subset of routes: reroutes to other nodes are failing for requests to /v1/generate on host pool A. Roughly 8-12% errors for redwood-7b in us-east-1, others ok.

Alex M: ok first triage: confirm node status and whether it's kernel panic or network. running: `kubectl get nodes gpu-node-8b-12 -o wide`

Alex M: output: `NotReady   3m   kubelet,container-runtime`

Alex M: trying `ssh root@gpu-node-8b-12` — connection times out.

Irene: I've pulled cust telemetry — 4 customers with active requests hit timeouts; alerts to CS created (CS-1421..CS-1424).

Samir: paging PD escalation if node stays down >5m. shifting traffic: can we cordon/drain and scale up extra pool?

Maya K: cordon + drain will only work if node is reachable to kubelet. If it's unreachable we should remove from LB routing and trigger fallback pool. Alex — can you mark node as unschedulable from control plane?

Alex M: running: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-8b-12` -> error: node not found/unreachable in API? means apiserver still sees node but kubelet not responding.

Alex M: executing node eviction via `kubectl delete node gpu-node-8b-12` as last resort to force scheduler to reschedule pods. Anyone object?

Samir: do it. make sure we have spare capacity in pool B. I'll bump autoscaler to immediate scale for inference-pool-B by +4 GPUs.

Alex M: deleted node object. pods are entering Pending and getting scheduled onto inference-pool-B.

ops-bot: autoscaler: scaling inference-pool-B from 6 -> 10 GPUs (requested by Samir). ETA ~2m.

Maya K: good. start failover for traffic: update route table / LB to prefer pool-B for model redwood-7b. I'm updating Canary route.

Maya K: applied canary (10% -> pool-B). monitoring latency/errors.

Samir: initial metrics: 10% canary looks good — error rate for canary path 0.5% vs 11% on affected pool. continue ramp.

Alex M: tried `journalctl -k -b -1` via rescue console (mounted disk) — found repeated kernel oops traces, GPU driver stack dump ending with "kernel panic - not syncing". Looks like a GPU driver/kernel crash.

Irene: customer impact update for CS: affected customers see increased 5xx and timeouts for redwood-7b only in us-east-1. Suggested mitigation: switch to dedicated fallbacks or use other model variants for now. CS notified.

Maya K: ramping traffic to pool-B 100% for redwood-7b. Redirect rules updated.

Samir: after reroute, global error rate for /v1/generate down to baseline. No customer facing impact expected now. keeping monitoring for 15m.

Alex M: opening incident ticket INC-2026-0421. Summary: gpu-node-8b-12 kernel panic -> kubelet NotReady -> node removed, pods rescheduled. Action items: collect node disk and dmesg, capture driver versions, mark host for repro and OOB investigation.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0421 (sev: high) — assigned to Alex M, Samir.

Irene: CS post created and customers notified with mitigation and ETA for root cause analysis.

Alex M: taking the host out of rotation for now. tagging node as 'forensic' in inventory.

Maya K: will own the immediate traffic mitigation and postmortem timeline. noted for follow-up with kernel team.

Samir: recommendation: pin affected nodes to older NVIDIA driver until we root cause, and add kubelet heartbeat checks to escalate slower. Also add a runbook entry: if kernel panic detected, immediate delete node + scale up fallback pool.

Alex M: leaving a note for handoff — I need to head off shift in 20m. Maya, you have the incident.

Maya K: got it. will monitor 30m and start postmortem doc. tagging @oncall-nextshift for handoff.

sre-oncall: acknowledged handoff. I'll pick up at 02:00 UTC.

ops-bot: Log snapshot uploaded to INC-2026-0421: /var/log/forensic/gpu-node-8b-12-2026-03-14.tar.gz

Alex M: closing pager for now — PD12345 resolved (automatic) since alert firing rate stopped after failover. Any new alerts will re-open.

incident-bot: PD12345: Alert resolved by user action (node removed and traffic rerouted).

Maya K: postmortem checklist: collect kernel oops, driver version, kubelet logs pre-crash, autoscaler timeline, LB route changes, customer impact summary. Assign owners and SLO/regression items.

Irene: CS follow-up: drafted email to 4 affected customers explaining mitigation and next steps, offering credits if SLA breached.

Samir: I'll open a tracking ticket to add more aggressive cross-pool failover and test chaos scenarios for kernel panic specifically.

Maya K: thanks all. leaving thread here and re-open if anything new. :thumbsup:
